base: Photorealistic fashion photograph, natural colour, no text, no watermark. A male model in his mid-20s with short dark hair wearing a cream oversized heavyweight cotton T-shirt, taupe wide-leg trousers and white leather sneakers.
studio: Seamless warm-grey studio backdrop with a matte beige micro-concrete floor, soft diffused daylight.

items.shots.ecu: Extreme close-up: only the model's eye and eyebrow fill the frame, eyelashes and skin pores razor sharp, the stitched collar edge of the cream T-shirt just visible at the bottom. 100mm macro lens, shallow focus. STUDIO
items.shots.cu: Close-up: the face and upper chest fill the frame, the T-shirt collar visible, calm expression looking straight at the camera, 85mm lens. STUDIO
items.shots.ms: Medium shot from the waist up, centered, arms relaxed, looking at the camera. STUDIO
items.shots.fs: Full shot, head to toe, standing centered with a little headroom, floor and backdrop visible around him. STUDIO
items.shots.ls: Long shot: the model is small in the frame, standing alone in a vast empty brutalist concrete plaza at dusk, the architecture dominates, overcast light, 35mm lens.
items.shots.ews: Extreme wide shot: the model is a tiny distant figure, a dot in an endless flat white salt desert under a huge pale sky, 24mm lens, epic scale, horizon low in the frame.
items.shots.ots: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the model: his cream T-shirt shoulder and the back of his head large and out of focus in the foreground on the left, the camera looking past him down an empty city street at dusk.
items.shots.pov: First-person point-of-view shot: looking down at my own cream oversized T-shirt, my hands pulling the hem, taupe wide-leg trousers and white sneakers on a concrete floor below, 24mm lens, no face visible.
items.shots.bird: Bird's-eye view from directly above, straight down like a drone: the model lying flat on his back on the matte beige concrete floor, arms slightly out, the whole body seen from the top.
items.shots.worm: Worm's-eye view: the camera on the floor looking steeply up at the model, he towers tall and powerful against the studio backdrop, 24mm lens. STUDIO
items.shots.dutch: Dutch angle: the camera tilted 25 degrees so the horizon and the model lean diagonally across the frame, full shot on a city rooftop at dusk.
items.lens.uw: Shot on a 14mm ultra-wide lens: extreme perspective, the concrete lines of an underpass stretching and bending around the model standing at the center, full shot, strong distortion at the edges.
items.lens.wide: Shot on a 28mm wide lens: full shot with lots of environment, the model seated on the ground of a wide empty street at dusk, buildings receding dynamically behind him.
items.lens.std: Shot on a 50mm lens: natural human-eye perspective, lookbook full shot. STUDIO
items.lens.port: Shot on an 85mm portrait lens at f/1.8: medium close-up, the studio background melting into soft blur, the model sharply isolated. STUDIO
items.lens.tele: Shot on a 200mm telephoto lens: medium shot, flat compressed background, distant city lights at night reduced to soft flat shapes behind the model.
items.lsrc.natural: Lit only by natural light from an overcast sky through a large window on the left, soft and realistic, medium shot in a bare white room.
items.lsrc.strobe: Lit by a studio strobe through a large softbox placed at 45 degrees, controlled clean commercial light on a white seamless, full shot.
items.lsrc.practical: In a lived-in apartment at night, lit only by visible practical lamps in the frame: a floor lamp and a desk lamp glowing warm, medium shot, realistic.
items.lsrc.flash: Shot with hard direct on-camera flash at night outside a club: harsh flat light on the model, the background falling off to black, candid Y2K party energy, medium shot.
items.lsrc.neon: Lit by neon and LED accents: magenta and cyan rim light on a wet night street, neon signs glowing behind him, medium shot.
items.lsrc.fire: Lit only by warm candlelight, dozens of candles around him in a dark room, intimate and mystical, medium close-up.
items.ldir.front: Front-lit: the single light coming from the camera position, flat even illumination, almost no shadows, catalogue clean, medium shot. STUDIO
items.ldir.side: Side-lit from camera left by a single hard key light: a Rembrandt triangle of light on the shadow cheek, deep sculptural shadows, the cotton texture visible, medium shot, dark grey backdrop.
items.ldir.back: Backlit: a strong light directly behind the model wrapping the edges of his body, face in soft shadow, a glowing halo on the hair and shoulders, medium shot, dark backdrop.
items.ldir.rim: Rim light only: a light from behind and to the right draws a thin bright edge around his silhouette, separating him from a near-black background, moody medium shot.
items.ldir.top: Top light from directly above: deep downward shadows under the brows, nose and chin, mysterious, dark surround, medium close-up.
items.ldir.under: Lit from below: a single light on the floor pointing up at the face, surreal unsettling upward shadows, medium close-up, dark room.
items.lq.soft: Soft wrapping light from a huge diffuser: gentle gradual shadows, flattering, medium close-up. STUDIO
items.lq.diffused: Even diffused light like an overcast sky: clean commercial, no visible shadows, full shot on a white seamless.
items.lq.hard: Hard light from a bare bulb: sharp-edged shadows thrown on the wall behind him, high contrast, every fold of the cotton visible, medium shot.
items.lq.warm: Warm 3200K golden-hour light at sunset: orange tones, long shadows, outdoors on a rooftop, medium shot.
items.lq.daylight: Neutral 5000K daylight: true natural colours, nothing warm or cool, medium shot. STUDIO
items.lq.cool: Cool 6500K bluish light: fog on an overcast morning in a field, cold distant mood, medium shot.
items.comp.centered: Centered symmetrical composition: the model standing exactly in the middle of a symmetrical concrete corridor, formal and iconic, full shot.
items.comp.thirds: Rule of thirds: the model placed on the left third line, a wide landscape of sand dunes filling the rest of the frame, balanced, full shot.
items.comp.negative: Generous negative space: the model small in the bottom right corner of the frame, a huge empty pale wall filling everything above and around him, full shot.
items.comp.leading: Leading lines: the model standing at the far end of a long corridor whose walls, floor lines and ceiling lights all converge on him, full shot.
items.comp.layers: Layered depth: out-of-focus leaves in the foreground, the model sharp in the midground, a blurred city in the background, medium shot.
items.comp.symmetry: Strict symmetry: two identical models in the same outfit mirrored on either side of the frame, a centered doorway behind them, full shot.
items.tex.cotton: Extreme close-up of the heavyweight cream cotton T-shirt fabric on the model's shoulder: visible weave, weighty folds, natural drape, macro lens, soft side light.
items.tex.knit: Close-up of a chunky ribbed knit sweater in oatmeal on the model's chest: the rib texture clearly visible, macro lens, soft side light.
items.tex.fleece: Close-up of a grey hoodie with the cuff turned back to show the brushed fleece interior against the matte cotton face, macro lens.
items.tex.concrete: Close-up of a matte beige micro-concrete studio floor meeting a grey seamless wall, the model's white sneakers and trouser hem at the edge of the frame.
items.tex.skin: Close-up of the model's face: realistic skin with visible pores, fine lines and natural imperfections, no retouching, 100mm macro, soft window light.
items.tex.suede: Close-up of worn brown suede boots with patina and leather creasing, the taupe trouser hem stacked above them, concrete floor.
items.move.frame: Full shot, head to toe, standing centered with headroom, looking at the camera, a little floor and backdrop around him. STUDIO
items.aes.minimal: Minimalist aesthetic: neutral palette, lots of negative space, soft diffused light, clean and premium, full shot. STUDIO
items.aes.editorial: Editorial fashion campaign aesthetic: studio strobes, bold strong pose with one arm raised, glossy magazine finish, high production, full shot on a coloured seamless.
items.aes.cinematic: Cinematic aesthetic: low-key light, haze in the air, shallow depth of field, teal and amber filmic grade, night street with headlights behind, medium shot.
items.aes.gritty: Gritty dark aesthetic: high contrast, desaturated, harsh side light, rough urban concrete texture, night, medium shot.
items.aes.dreamy: Dreamy soft aesthetic: soft haze, bloom, pastel pink and lilac light, gentle and nostalgic, medium shot.
items.aes.retro: Retro vintage aesthetic: warm 90s film tones, visible grain, slight softness, shot on 35mm film, full shot in a parking lot.
items.aes.tech: Futuristic tech aesthetic: neon rim light, chrome surfaces, clean geometry, dark, full shot.
items.pose.stand: Standing straight, centered, arms relaxed at the sides, looking at the camera, full shot. STUDIO
items.pose.back: Standing with his back to the camera, head slightly turned, full shot. STUDIO
items.pose.pockets: Standing with both hands in the trouser pockets, relaxed, full shot. STUDIO
items.pose.threeq: Turned three-quarters, looking off frame to the left, candid and thoughtful, full shot. STUDIO
items.pose.stool: Seated on a low wooden stool, elbows on knees, hands clasped, looking at the camera, low camera angle, full shot. STUDIO
items.pose.floor: Sitting on the floor, knees up, the soles of the white sneakers toward the camera, leaning back on his hands, low camera angle, full shot. STUDIO
items.pose.collar: Adjusting the collar of the T-shirt with both hands, chin up, low angle, medium shot. STUDIO
items.pose.hood: Wearing a cream oversized hoodie instead of the T-shirt, hood up, hands in the pouch pocket, face half in shadow, medium shot. STUDIO
items.pose.bowed: Head bowed, eyes down, hands in pockets, introspective, full shot. STUDIO
items.pose.walk: Walking slowly toward the camera, mid-step, the fabric moving, full shot. STUDIO
items.pose.stride: Mid-stride in full side profile, the wide-leg trouser silhouette clear, full shot. STUDIO
items.pose.lean: Leaning one shoulder against a concrete wall, one foot crossed over the other, on a rooftop at dusk, full shot.
items.pose.crouch: Crouching low on one knee, looking at the camera, the sneakers and trousers in the foreground, full shot. STUDIO

static.prompt: Static locked-off camera, no camera movement at all. The model stands still, breathes, shifts his weight slightly and looks at the lens.

push.prompt: Slow smooth push-in toward the model, the camera gliding gently closer from a full shot to a medium shot. The model stands still, looking at the lens.

pan.prompt: Slow steady pan from left to right across the empty concrete plaza, revealing the small figure of the model standing still. No other camera movement.

track.prompt: Smooth steady tracking shot following the model from the side as he walks across the studio, the camera moving with him at the same speed, keeping him centered.

tilt.prompt: Slow tilt up from the white sneakers to the face, the camera pivoting upward along the body, revealing the outfit bottom to top. The model stands still.

aerial.prompt: Slow controlled aerial drone shot from high above, drifting forward over the white salt desert, the tiny figure of the model standing still far below.

orbit.prompt: Very slow orbit: the camera circles a quarter turn around the model at a constant distance while he stands still and looks straight ahead.

handheld.prompt: Steady controlled handheld camera, subtle natural sway, as the model stands and looks at the lens. No other camera movement.
